research_question: Under the exact same historical simulator build, scene inputs, target identities and creation-state geometry definition, can a transport-resilient fresh extraction recover valid AABB geometry for all 368 broad targets / 200 tasks while exactly reproducing the 20 previously completed full tasks?
hypothesis: H-COMPLETE-RUNTIME-GEOMETRY: the prior blocker was transport-only; a fresh 200-task run with durable task checkpoints and no inherited stdout dependency will exactly reproduce the prior 20-task overlap and recover valid creation-state AABB geometry for 368/368 targets and complete summaries for 200/200 tasks.
competing_explanation: H-LATE-RUNTIME-GAP: later tasks contain runtime-ID, scene-loading, geometry-validity or stability failures; the prior BrokenPipe happened before those could be observed.
reference: Frozen BLOCKED result ac2c9fe80f113345f5092205b07192a47a0e0358: exact build identity recovered, 18/18 preflight repeat comparisons exact, first 20 full tasks complete, 26/26 attempted full targets exact-mapped valid AABB, then BrokenPipe on stdout progress.
repeat_or_treatment: Measurement repeat/completion. Freshly rerun all 200 tasks once. First 20 tasks are a cross-cycle overlap control against the prior partial result; final dataset must come entirely from the fresh cycle.
unique_variable: Only transport/checkpoint implementation changes: no inherited stdout/stderr dependency, atomic per-task durable records and per-task progress manifest. Simulator build, inputs, target mapping and creation-state geometry semantics remain fixed.
fixed_conditions: Re-hash runtime executable/Unity/source identity before scene initialization and require accepted identity
Same archived 200 task specs and same scene/asset inputs as prior cycle
Outcome-blind: do not read success/failure, episode length, Safety Cost, visible pixels, category SR or other outcomes
No SafeVLA model/checkpoint import/load, no Actor/Critic forward, no navigation policy action, no ObjectNav evaluation episode
Exactly one fresh scene initialization per task; max 200
Exact runtime object-ID mapping only; no fuzzy matching
Primary descriptor remains initial creation-state world-axis AABB; OBB secondary only
No B0/runtime source, task-spec, success/end, reset/cache or historical-outcome modification
No implicit resume after any post-start failure
metrics: Overlap exact-equal target count and max absolute/relative AABB-vector difference
Per-complete-task median AABB volume and median maximum side
Durable checkpoint consistency across per-task records, progress manifest and final CSV
expected_result: Fresh run exactly reproduces the prior first 20 tasks, then completes 368/368 valid AABBs and 200/200 task summaries without transport interruption. This removes the geometry-measurement blocker but does not test H-SIZE.
falsifying_result: Any runtime identity mismatch, non-exact first-20 overlap, target mapping/AABB failure, incomplete task, >200 scene initializations, or post-start transport/process failure blocks complete recovery. Partial data cannot be spliced with the prior cycle to claim full coverage.
alternative_explanations: Later scenes/assets expose metadata gaps not present in the first 20 tasks
Some archived runtime object IDs are unstable or unmatched
Creation-state asset/physics hooks cause later geometry failures
The earlier stdout crash hid a later scientific coverage gap
World-axis AABB is reproducible but orientation-dependent rather than intrinsic size
Historical executable byte equality was not contemporaneously archived despite matched build/source identity
stop_conditions: Any outcome-derived file/column would be needed
Any SafeVLA model/policy component would need to load
Any navigation/policy action would be needed
Any task requires fuzzy target mapping
Any primary AABB is invalid or missing
Completion would require more than 200 scene initializations
Any size-success association, Probe, replay, reset treatment, Safe-vs-IL comparison or B0 evaluation would start
